tests.name: World, four elemental camps, respawns, pens and named models
0.4.0 rules validate, Speed is monotonic/bounded, and Night cadence stays bounded
Rarity, creature, and element are independent across all supported combinations
Momentum, Overdrive bounds, fractional Coin credit, and Exchange values are deterministic
Training accrues only on own treadmill
Remote pickup cannot bypass proximity
Bat drops carried egg with BossEnabled false; no shared base ownership
Day hatch countdown and real 30x night acceleration
All four elements hatch independent Dragon variants without changing rarity
Night dormancy, hidden egg lifecycle, and cross-sunrise contests preserve ownership
All sixteen creature-element models are constructible and distinct
Pen paging keeps every displayed pet within the pen and preserves income
Egg storage preserves unhatched creature identity at the owner's camp only
Upgrade price, ownership, double-purchase rejection
Safe-zone bat and snare rejection
Snare arms, affects only carriers, expires slow independently of boss
Duel decline changes no ownership
Offer ownership, stale confirmation, revision reset and cancel
Both confirmations create exact escrow and equip both blasters
Blaster finite-input guard and real arena cover occlusion
Five real damage eliminations finish once; selected pet transfers income ownership
Offer timeout returns to the world without item loss
Client HUD, collection key input, tool bindings and post-duel camera
Warden catches after unpause and returns finite transforms home
Death respawn returns to the owner's marked pad with normal gear
Warden navigation does not tunnel through a wall
Actual client disconnect cancels selection without escrow loss
